records.title: The finite canonical-tail safety SCC is a cofinite artifact
records.statement: For every fixed safety depth, the forbidden set is finite, the safe language is cofinite, the terminal two-state canonical tail is the unique cyclic SCC, the remaining boundary is acyclic, and an exact power-of-two witness shows nonclosure.
records.scope: The fixed-depth LSD-first canonical safety language of PR #14.
exclusions: Arbitrary regular or infinite-state sanctuaries remain outside scope.

records.title: Finite tame sections cannot self-replicate the reviewed six-branch chart
records.statement: In the exact P=3^12, Q=2^19 six-branch chart, the high quotient leaves the same language; complete-tree finite affine sections collapse to the expanding forward map; complete-tree finite rational sections do likewise under eventual integrality; and the full-tail survivor has no infinite arithmetic progression or semilinear forward-invariant sanctuary.
records.scope: The exact six-branch chart under complete-tree, full-tail, finite-control, and eventual-integrality hypotheses.
exclusions: No generic claim about all finite or rational Collatz representations.
Proper sublanguages, algebraic extensions, unbounded nonlinear state, and the least-root decision remain open.

review.verdict: verified with namespace and dependency fixes

records.title: Universal itinerary factor-complexity barrier is false
records.statement: The unrestricted PR37:T-9318 screen is false: the constant words 0^infinity and 1^infinity have factor complexity one while selecting the stationary ordinary completion zero.
records.scope: The exact unrestricted screening statement at the reviewed PR #37 head.
exclusions: The centered equivalence and recurrence cone are not refuted.

records.title: Nonconstant itinerary factor-complexity barrier
records.statement: In the reviewed 64-to-81 centered section, nontrivial ordinary itineraries obey a strict factor-complexity lower bound; a nonconstant word with slope strictly below 1/log_64(81/64) cannot have eventually zero cylinder blocks.
records.scope: Nontrivial ordinary 64-to-81 survivors and nonconstant words in the reviewed centered-cylinder model.
exclusions: The equality slope is not excluded.
The theorem does not apply to every Collatz itinerary.
